description: Keep a write-up (a test run, a review, what you did) on a step, where the Developer and every chat can read it, instead of writing it to a file nobody finds. Works from any chat in the project, even one that holds no goal: then give goal. Give text (markdown) or the path of a .md or .txt file, up to 200 KB, and a short title. Read it with get_item progressor://<goal>/<id>. To take one back, pass remove with its ID (such as 'r2').

goal.description: The Goal's ID; needed unless this chat holds exactly one Goal.

path.description: Instead of text: a .md or .txt file, absolute or from the project's (or this chat's own worktree) folder.

remove.description: The ID of a report to remove (such as 'r2'), instead of attaching one.

task.description: The ID of the step it is about, such as 't3'.

title.description: A short title for the report.

name: attach_report
title: Attach report
